topics.headline: Nowcasts point to higher US CPI and Eurozone HICP in September
topics.summary: Cleveland Fed nowcast and TD Securities project US headline CPI YoY rising above August’s 3.4% in September; ECB staff projections and August’s jump from 2.9% to 3.2% suggest Eurozone HICP will also print higher, though no precise September consensus was identified.

topics.headline: ICE BofA US HY OAS at 2.80%, near historical lows
topics.summary: Current OAS of 2.80% (as of Sep 2024) is 27% below its long-term average of 3.85% and sits in the richest historical decile versus a long-run median near 450 bps. No forward-looking 30-day forecasts or event risks were identified.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETFs Likely to See Net Inflows Next Week
topics.summary: Recent mixed flows have included short outflow streaks that historically reverse to positive weekly nets, supported by stable BTC price and analyst correlation to momentum.

topics.headline: VIX at 14.87 below 3M avg 16.05, term structure in contango
topics.summary: Spot VIX closed well below its three-month average and the VIX3M index, with the term structure in contango and known mean-reversion dynamics both pointing to a likely rise over the next 30 days.

topics.headline: No major hyperscaler AI power PPA announced in Sept 2026
topics.summary: Recent precedents from Microsoft, Amazon, and Google show frequent nuclear and renewable PPAs for AI data centers, driven by surging power demand projected to double by 2030, but no new dedicated generation or PPA deals from major players appeared in September 2026 news.
